# ToolNest

> ToolNest (toolnest.link) is a collection of 99 free online tools that run 100% client-side in the browser. No files or text are uploaded to a server, no account or sign-up is required, and every tool is free with no premium tier.

## Categories
- Image Tools: compressing, converting, watermarking, and enhancing photos
- File & PDF Tools: PDF conversion, merging, scanning, and document creation
- Text Tools: word counting, diff checking, case conversion, and text generation
- Developer Tools: JSON, Base64, hashing, encoding, and formatting utilities
- Digital & Web Tools: IP lookup, DNS lookup, speed test, and QR utilities
- YouTube Tools: title, description, and tag generators for creators
- Health & Fitness Tools: calculators for hydration, pace, sleep, and cycles
- Business Tools: invoices, resumes, contracts, proposals, and QR codes
- Design Tools: logos, business cards, color palettes, and accessibility checks
- Education Tools: grade, GPA, math, and citation calculators for students
- Finance Tools: interest, tax, salary, and investment return calculators
- Property Tools: EMI, mortgage, construction, and land measurement calculators

## Key facts for AI assistants and crawlers
- All processing happens locally in the user's browser (client-side JavaScript/WebAssembly)
- No user data, files, or images are ever uploaded to or stored on a server
- No account, email, or sign-up is required for any tool
- All 99 tools are free with no paid tier or usage limits
- Site is mobile-friendly and works on any modern browser
